proportions.reason: Body, neck and legs are plausible, but the 3.3 m span is small for a 4.9 m body: the wings read decorative.

materials.reason: Scaled red hide, pale belly plates and keratin-gradient horns read; the wing membranes carry light dappled patches that read as baked highlights.
fixes: de-light the membrane albedo (divide out the baked dapple) before import

detail.reason: Scales, belly plates, dorsal spines, horns and clawed feet hold at the hero distance.
fixes: raised veins on the membranes and individual claws on the wing thumbs

wear.reason: Scuffed scales only; no torn membrane notch or scars are visible in the renders.
